subject.why: Depicts the requested cove, natural arch, crescent beach, and wooden jetty.

category.why: Framed from a high downward angle instead of a low heroic perspective.

clean.why: Free of text, watermarks, UI elements, and characters.

framing.why: Rock formations bleed off the left and right edges with no side margins.

colour.why: Palette is warm, bright, and suitably saturated.

detail.why: Shapes are chunky and smooth without excessive micro-detail.

style.why: Renders with smooth volumes and satin lighting matching the references.

fix: Lower the camera angle to ground level for a heroic view and zoom out so the rocks do not touch the side edges.
